notes: Top street printed 'STREET' in the strip and 'VIADUCT' east of Fairbanks: West 8th Street (its north edge is the plate edge, so y is approximate, about 210). The avenue running south from 8th at x 8925 prints only 'AVENUE' at the top; it is continuous with the street printed FAIRBANKS AVENUE further south, so named Fairbanks Avenue. Steiner Street: the vertical street is printed STEINER, its diagonal part 'ST.'; the unlabelled 40 ft street from the Fairbanks bend (x 8813, y 4712-5310) is taken as its continuation. Frank Vanderhorst Street is a 25 ft street printed 'FRANK VANDERHORST ST.' running SE to Fairbanks. Bottom-left street (40 ft, 6" W. pipe) meeting Fairbanks at the plate's bottom edge prints only 'AVENUE' (further west); name '?'. Edwin Avenue lies along the plate's bottom edge; its south side is the plate edge. Mabel Street label reads 'ST. G' near its north end and MABEL further south. Terry and McPherson, Wells and Fairbanks continue north of 8th as stubs off the plate.
